title: Règne Delta (ME06) is out Friday 6 November
detail: Mega Rayquaza ex is the chase card (special illustration and Mega Hyper Rare). Miyata Kard Market lists it for 6 Nov; ask Sortilèges and Planet Geek about displays now, before allocations run out.

title: Règne Delta displays: €166 to €240 on pre-order
detail: Pokémon Center Germany has the 36-pack display at €165.99; French shops ask €190–240 (LorenZone €239.90). Shipping and import fees to Réunion can wipe out the gap, so compare with the island shops' price first.

title: 30th Celebration chase cards are 13–20% under their monthly average
detail: Mew ex 152 is at €78 against a 30-day average of €105. Prices are still sliding after launch, so there's no rush, but this is the cheapest they've been.

title: Classic Collection Lugia down to €169
detail: Its 30-day average was €204. Charizard from the same collection is at €150.

title: Japanese OP-05 boxes up 19% in four weeks
detail: Median eBay sale $210. OP-11 is up 15% to $120, while the newer OP-17 box slipped 9% to $117.

title: Heroines Edition vol.2 (EB-05) is out, and French boosters are selling out
detail: Released 30 Oct in English and French at about €9.90 a pack. Play-in is already out of stock in French; check the Réunion shops. Nico Robin and Nami SP cards are the chase.

title: Regionals in Porto and Sydney this Saturday, 7 November
detail: The first big events since the Mihawk ban. Results will show which leaders, and which cards, are worth watching.
